title: After updating from MLM 5.1.3, domain logins have stopped working in SSSD | SUSE | Support Center
plain_text:
After updating from MLM 5.1.3, domain logins have stopped working in SSSD
Environment
Help Environment

SUSE Multi-Linux Manager (MLM) >= 5.1.3.1
SUSE Multi-Linux Manager (MLM) 5.1.3

Situation

MLM UI domain logins using Kerberos (via sssd-ad, sssd-krb, or sssd-ldap with SASL/GSSAPI/GSS-SPNEGO) have stopped working after updating from MLM 5.1.3.

Resolution

From the host, update the file ownership of the uyuni-server container's /etc/rhn/krb5.conf file and /etc/rhn/krb5.conf.d directory. Change the owner and group to root:root.

mgrctl exec -- "chown -R root:root /etc/rhn/krb5.conf{,.d/*} ; systemctl restart sssd"
Cause

The version of SSSD used in MLM >= 5.1.3.1 introduces a functional change to how the SSSD service runs. SSSD has been reverted to run under the privileged root user. However, because the container environment enforces restricted capabilities, even root cannot read Kerberos files that were previously changed to be owned by the sssd user. Because the SSSD container uses different paths for Kerberos files due to the persistent etc-rhn volume, this ownership change from sssd to root must be performed manually.

Additional Information
Updating the sssd package in MLM 5.0.7 and 5.1.3 breaks AD
